For vegetables, speared zucchini and sweet corn roast swiftly on the grill. Brushed with olive oil and salt, they keep their sweetness and need no further persuasion.  

A salad of mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, and cucumber, dressed with lemon and olive oil, refresheth the palate after heartier fare. Let the guests help themselves from a communal bowl, thus avoiding any waste.  

For desserts, simple is best. A bowl of ripe berries, perhaps a dab of cream, suits all ages. Should the sun grow warm, chilled fruit sorbet doth provide a cooling finish.

Arrange the food in stations: one for meats, one for vegetables, one for bread, and one for desserts. Thus thy guests shall move at leisure, selecting what pleases them.  

Should the weather turn, have a shaded area prepared. A canopy or the shelter of trees keeps the feast comfortable, and thy company grateful.  

Thus equipped, thou shalt serve a banquet that honours both child and adult, and none shall leave unsatisfied.
